tickerText: [TENNIS] Defending champion Alex de Minaur beat 17-year-old Cruz Hewitt 6-2, 6-3 to reach the Washington Open quarterfinals, while WTA qualifying continues at the National Bank Open in Toronto ahead of main-draw play Sunday • [SQUASH] The Dallas Squash Challenger is underway in Plano, Texas, with top seeds Juan Torres and Nathan Kueh leading the 32-player field through August 2 • [BADMINTON] The BWF World Championships in New Delhi unveiled mascot Peacko and an official anthem as the 30-day countdown begins for the August 17–23 event • [PICKLEBALL] The Wisconsin PPA Challenger wraps August 2 in Lake Hallie, with the PPA Asia 500 Ho Chi Minh City Open set for August 6–9 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Yokohama opens August 4, while Sun Yingsha will lead China at the Europe Smash in Malmö from August 8 as world No. 1 Wang Chuqin rests

newsItems.title: De Minaur Tops Hewitt in DC
newsItems.excerpt: Defending champion Alex de Minaur eased past 17-year-old qualifier Cruz Hewitt 6-2, 6-3 to reach the Washington Open quarterfinals and will face Brandon Nakashima next.

newsItems.title: Dallas Challenger Hits QF Stage
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Dallas Squash Challenger continues in Plano, Texas, through August 2, with top seeds Juan Torres and Nathan Kueh among the contenders in the $6,000 event.

newsItems.title: Peacko Unveiled for Worlds
newsItems.excerpt: India launched mascot Peacko and an official anthem as the 30-day countdown begins for the BWF World Championships in New Delhi, running August 17–23.

newsItems.title: Europe Smash Draws Near
newsItems.excerpt: Sun Yingsha will headline China at the WTT Europe Smash in Malmö from August 8–16, while world No. 1 Wang Chuqin rests ahead of the $1.55 million Grand Smash.
